'''Aaron Watkin''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[1999 Tatooine Regionals]] in September 1999 with [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|Ralltiir Ops / sleens]], according to Michael Girard's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d54">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-27-tatooine-regional-w-rantd54/ tatooine-regional-w-rant], DeckTech (Michael "Dvader" Girard, 27 September 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-27-tatooine-regional-w-rantd54/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
